question: Should CodexBar expose persistent per-provider confetti palette editing in every provider settings pane, or ship only automatic branded defaults?
rationale: Automatic provider branding solves the stated visual problem, while the editor adds a durable preference, validation behavior, localization, and ongoing settings UI that requires explicit product ownership.

options.title: Ship branded defaults only
options.body: Keep descriptor palettes and overlay wiring, but remove the persistent override store and settings editor for a narrower feature.

options.title: Accept the full editor
options.body: Keep persistent overrides after the contributor demonstrates the complete settings and relaunch workflow in a freshly built bundle.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer both branded defaults and customization if provider-specific celebration styling is not desired product behavior.

recommendation.title: Ship branded defaults only
recommendation.body: Keep descriptor palettes and overlay wiring, but remove the persistent override store and settings editor for a narrower feature.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and explicit routing from the prior review make this the best available product-direction owner.
